name: Michael Neff's Gin-Applejack Punch

ingredients.name: freshly squeezed lime juice, from about 5 whole limes

instructions.primary_message: 8 hours in advance, make a large ice block (or extra-large ice cubes) for serving.

Meanwhile, a few hours before serving, cut oranges into slices and muddle a few at a time in shaker. Strain and discard pulp and orange peel. When you have 57 g of juice, add Angostura bitters. Pour into resealable 750-milliliter bottle (using funnel if desired.)
Add gin, applejack, lime juice, simple syrup, and water. Seal bottle and shake to blend. Refrigerate until completely chilled. Serve in a punch bowl over ice, garnishing with lime slices.

description: We asked Michael Neff of Ward III in Tribeca to design a cocktail that we could make in a big batch for our office cookie exchange party. The only ingredient we stipulated was applejack. But we didn't want typical fall flavors: no ginger or nutmeg, no cinnamon. Been there, done that.
notes:
Total time, including resting: 9 hr 10 min.

Optional or for serving: Large block of ice for serving; Thin lime slices for garnish
author: Maggie Hoffman
